name: Rogues & Fate
description:
About This Game

Build two heroes into an unstoppable party through endless combinations of weapons, relics, runes, summons, and positioning. Take advantage of chaotic synergies and powerful passives to break the game and become overpowered. Shape your run through dangerous paths, prepare for unique events, and prove your party can outlast every challenge in both single-player and asynchronous 2v2 Duels.

From unlikely survivors to an unstoppable duo, your heroes grow stronger with every battle. Discover powerful loot, forge outrageous synergies, and turn two ordinary adventurers into a party capable of overcoming impossible odds.

From devastating warriors and master spellcasters, to ancient relics, powerful runes, loyal summons, and cursed contracts, every run offers countless ways to build your party. Discover outrageous synergies across two heroes, awaken ancient relics, command loyal summons, and unleash devastating combinations to bring down your enemies!

Every hero begins with their own starting passive, signature equipment, and exclusive relics, but your party doesn't have to stop there. Recruit Fallen Heroes throughout events to unlock their unique loot, mix powerful gear across different heroes, and discover endless combinations that turn even the most unlikely party into an unstoppable force.

Asynchronous 2v2 Duels let you put your best party to the test against other players' builds during a run. Climb the leaderboards, prove your strategies, and show that your heroes deserve a place among the strongest.

Ascension challenges you with tougher enemies, deadlier curses, and greater rewards as you climb through increasingly difficult runs. Push every build to its limits and discover just how far your strongest heroes can go.

Meta Progression unlocks new starting passives, equipment, and possibilities for every hero, giving every run fresh opportunities to experiment with even more outrageous combinations.

Build Two Heroes, Create Broken Builds. Experiment with endless combinations of weapons, relics, runes, summons, and Fallen Hero loot. Every Choice Shapes Your Run, and every run is another chance to discover a build more broken than the last.

FEATURES

  • Two heroes, two grids, thousands of combinations.

  • Organize your inventory and stack item synergies.

  • Auto-battle combat: pause and fast-forward up to 3x anytime.

  • Explore a branching map of zones, every one with its own bizarre creatures to defeat.

  • Multiple heroes, each with their own gear and relics.

  • Merge and upgrade items into higher tiers.

  • Escalating ascension difficulties.

  • Asynchronous 2v2 duels against other players' builds.

  • Full controller support.

  • Playable one-handed on keyboard.

short_desc: A fast-paced two-hero inventory management roguelike. Assemble your inventory and crush bizarre creatures. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to defeat the Fate King in this RPG auto battler.
